meta.name: identity-lifecycle-administration
meta.description: Executes joiner, mover and leaver processes — provisioning, group membership, access changes on role change, and complete deprovisioning. Use this to set up or fix joiner-mover-leaver, deprovision someone completely, clean up accumulated access, audit group membership, or find accounts that outlived their owners.

copy.tagline: 自动完成员工入职、调动、离职的权限调整
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要管理员工账号从入职到离职的全流程权限
copy.tagline_en: Automate user access updates for joins, moves, and departures.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage employee accounts and need to keep permissions right.

howto.what: Claude将按照该技能执行人员加入、调动、离职时的权限变更,如分配、修改和删除访问权限,并支持清理累积权限、审计组成员和发现孤儿账户。
howto.when: 当你提出处理员工加入、调动、离职的权限流程,或要求彻底删除访问、清理遗留权限时触发。

say.text: 为张三执行离职流程,彻底移除他的所有访问权限。
say.note: 会核查目录之外的本地账户、API密钥等。

say.text: 把李四从部门A调到部门B,撤销旧角色,按新角色重新授权。
say.note: 按撤销并重新供应处理,避免权限累积。

say.text: 审计IT部门的组成员,找出无人认领的账户。
say.note: 会列出无所有者的孤儿账户。

howto.what_en: Claude executes access changes for joiners, movers, and leavers—provisioning, modifying, and removing permissions—and can clean up accumulated access, audit group memberships, and find orphaned accounts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to handle joiner/mover/leaver processes, fully revoke someone's access, or clean up leftover permissions.

say_en.text: Run the full offboarding process for Zhang San and remove all his access.
say_en.note: Checks systems outside the directory, local accounts, and API keys.

say_en.text: Move Li Si from department A to B, revoke old role, and grant new role access.
say_en.note: Treats it as revoke-and-re-provision to avoid privilege buildup.

say_en.text: Audit IT group memberships and list accounts that have no owner.
say_en.note: Identifies orphaned accounts no one claims.
